Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_TX_LedCurrent_v2
Objects.description: LED current from the four hall monitors the TXC reads on EM_IFB1..4, one per emitter regulator, refreshed once per complete burst. Which emitter group each regulator drives belongs to the emitter, so the device's dashboard names them. A slot's value is its peak current - twice its mean, since the carrier is 0.5 + 0.5 sin of the peak - so a lit slot should read its regulator's set current. Section summaries come first, then every slot on every regulator: a slot that lights no string on a regulator reads near 0, which is how a stuck-on or dead string shows.

variables.name: bursts
variables.description: Bursts measured since power on; it steps each time the values below are refreshed

variables.name: set
variables.description: Set peak current per regulator, EM_IFB1..4: the one DAC reference through each regulator's own sense resistor

variables.name: zero
variables.description: Hall sensor reading at no current per regulator, EM_IFB1..4; subtracted from every value below

variables.name: median
variables.description: Median slot current per section and regulator: DPTF R1..R4, DACS R1..R4, ADS R1..R4. The section's current on that regulator; 0 with no settled slot

variables.name: min
variables.description: Lowest slot current per section and regulator, same order as median

variables.name: max
variables.description: Highest slot current per section and regulator, same order as median

variables.name: slots
variables.description: Lit slots measured per section and regulator in the burst, same order as median

variables.name: dacs
variables.description: DACS slots 1..4 per regulator: R1 slots 1..4, then R2, R3, R4
